text:
The sun like a great animal too yellow. It is lucky that no one

helps me. Nothing is more dangerous, when one needs help, than receiving help.


But no sun kills my night.


Will I have time to make myself a mask when I emerge from shadow?


I test myself in the language in which I verify the weight of my dead.


The sea hides its dead. Because what is below must remain below.

translation.title: The Sun Like a Great Animal Too Yellow...
translation.editorial_note: The prose-poem structure is kept taut, including the clipped logic around help and concealment.
